verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official MCP server that lets AI assistants operate a Brex account in natural language, covering expenses, users, cards, banking transactions and bills (brex-docs-3, brex-docs-24, brex-probe-3). Its marketing also describes AI assistants that handle employees' expenses and offer policy help (brex-docs-23). Missing for 10: detail on which actions can be performed by natural language versus only read, clear evidence of a native in-product natural-language command interface beyond marketing claims, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
